Subject: Post-call recap + ask: who owns the budget at VoltWare?

Hi Arielle — thanks again for a speedy demo today. Quick recap and the one ask we need to move to pricing: who is the budget owner / final approver for inference platform spend at VoltWare (name, title, best email)?

Recap (2/25 demo):
- Use case: real-time recommendations + search reranking for product pages (expected peak 60 qps)
- Goal: cut per-call inference cost while holding latency < 120ms P95
- Technical ask: need SOC 2 evidence and brief note on VPC/private deployment options

Next steps I propose:
1) We map the buying circle (economic buyer, procurement, security reviewers) — if you can share names we’ll prepare a short one-pager tailored to Tom/Finance and a procurement checklist for vendors.
2) I’ll send a very short outreach email you can forward to the budget owner (template included below).
3) If budget owner is receptive, schedule a 20-min call next week to align on numbers and procurement path.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (customer action plan draft) — quick sketch of milestones + approvals.

Template outreach you can forward:
"Hi {{Name}}, I spoke with Redwood Inference about reducing inference costs for VoltWare’s recommendations system. They can show a model and deployment plan that hits our latency and security needs and outline estimated monthly spend. Can I introduce them for a 20-min sync next week? — Arielle"

I'll wait for Tom's contact and any process notes from procurement/security.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: who owns the budget at VoltWare?

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Apologies for the delayed reply; I had to confirm internally.

Good news: the economic buyer is Tom Nguyen, VP Finance (tom.nguyen@voltware.com). Procurement handles contracting (procurement@voltware.com) and will own the final PO. Security will want our SOC 2 report and a short note on data residency (we host EU/US).

Notes from Security (quick):
- SOC 2 Type II required for vendor onboarding
- Data residency: production inference will run in our US region; we need confirmation there’s no EU data transfer for PII.

Budget cadence: Tom signs off on vendor spends > $25k ARR; anything below can be approved by the product owner + procurement. We’re targeting a pilot decision in the next 4–6 weeks.

If you can send: 1) SOC2 statement, 2) short cost estimate for a 3-month pilot (expected scale), and 3) one-pager for Tom, I’ll forward to him and procurement.

Thanks — Arielle
Head of Platform Partnerships
VoltWare
